name: Angilia
source: Angilia, High Priestess of the Order of the Scorching sun, rules the fiefdom of Oryenguk with an iron fist. Known for her astute financial instincts and unwavering devotion, Angilia's commanding presence is both alluring and formidable, her sensuality surpassed only by her devout piety.
